title: Mexican Taco, Fajita and Enchilada Filling + Sides
description: Make the filling once, put half away for tomorrow, then choose tacos, fajitas, enchiladas or a Mexican bowl. Pick whichever sides we fancy from the links at the end.
imageAlt: Reference photograph of crisp folded tacos filled with beef and melted cheese on a dark surface.
imageCaption: Reference photograph · beef-and-cheese taco variation · serving inspiration
personalNote: Put tomorrow’s half in a Tupperware as soon as the filling is ready. Then we can have a different version on the second night without cooking the whole thing again.
equipment: Oven and baking dish — for tacos or enchiladas
advancePrep: Choose the version for tonight, then pick whichever sides we fancy. Fresh choices start with the full mince batch. The chilled-filling choices start with the cooked half saved in the fridge.
importantNotes: Tacos and enchiladas bake at 180°C. With freshly cooked filling, bake for 15 minutes with cheese on from the start. With chilled filling, wet the shells or tortillas first and bake for 30 minutes, adding cheese halfway through. Check the centre is steaming hot before serving.

substitutions.title: Pick the mince
substitutions.text: Use 1 kg pork, turkey, beef or chicken mince for the full batch. Any of these works with the same filling method.

substitutions.title: No peppers?
substitutions.text: Leave them out. If we have them, use 2 bell peppers of whatever colour is available.

substitutions.title: Pick the seasoning
substitutions.text: Use 2 packets of taco or fajita seasoning for the full batch.

storage: Cool the reserved half quickly, refrigerate within 1–2 hours and use within 2 days.
reheating: Reheat the saved filling once until steaming hot throughout. The chilled taco and enchilada choices show the longer oven method. For fajitas or bowls, heat the saved filling through separately before serving.
foodSafety: All four types of mince need to be fully cooked. Check the thickest part with a clean food thermometer: at least 75°C.
servingSuggestion: Choose whichever sides we want. Guacamole is a two-night batch; each rice batch and the beans are for one dinner for both of us.
portionNote: Fresh-filling choices make 4 portions across two dinners: use half tonight and save half. The chilled-filling choices use that saved half for 2 portions on the second night.
choiceIntro: The filling works for all four dinners. Use a fresh-filling choice when making the big batch, or a chilled-filling choice for the saved half.

recipeOptions.label: Mexican bowl
recipeOptions.description: Make the full filling, save half and have tonight’s half with whichever sides we fancy.

groups.title: The full filling — for both nights

ingredients.name: Mince of choice
ingredients.note: Choose pork, turkey, beef or chicken mince. Use one.

beforeSteps.title: Get everything chopped
beforeSteps.description: Choose pork, turkey, beef or chicken mince. Chop the onion and the head of garlic. If we’re using bell peppers, chop those too; any colour is fine.

beforeSteps.title: Start browning the mince
beforeSteps.description: Heat the pan on medium-high heat and add the mince. Break it up and let it brown for about 5 minutes, until it is roughly halfway browned.

beforeSteps.title: Add the onion and garlic
beforeSteps.description: Add the chopped onion and garlic, turn the heat down to medium and cook for 10 minutes, squishing the mince around and breaking up any big lumps.

beforeSteps.title: Season it and add the peppers
beforeSteps.description: Add the taco or fajita seasoning — 2 packets for the full batch — and squish it through. Add the bell peppers if we’re using them and cook for another 10 minutes. If we’re skipping the peppers, give the seasoned mince the same cooking time. Check the mince is fully cooked through.
beforeSteps.doneness: Mince fully cooked through; a clean food thermometer should read at least 75°C.

beforeSteps.title: Put half away right now
beforeSteps.description: The filling is ready. Put half into a clean Tupperware for the second dinner, and use the other half tonight. Cool the saved filling quickly and refrigerate it promptly.
beforeSteps.tip: This is the full four-portion batch: two portions tonight and two saved for the next dinner.

afterSteps.title: Make the bowls
afterSteps.description: Spoon tonight’s half of the filling into bowls and add whichever sides we’re having. The guacamole, both rice options and beans are linked at the end of this card.

recipeOptions.label: Tacos · fresh filling
recipeOptions.description: Make the full batch, save half and bake tonight’s tacos for 15 minutes at 180°C, with cheese on from the start.

afterSteps.title: Fill them and add the cheese
afterSteps.description: Line the soft taco shells in a baking dish and spoon tonight’s half of the filling evenly into them. Sprinkle generously with the favourite cheese blend.

afterSteps.title: Bake for 15 minutes
afterSteps.description: Bake at 180°C for 15 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the filling is hot. Serve with whichever sides we fancy.

recipeOptions.label: Tacos · chilled filling
recipeOptions.description: Use the saved half straight from the fridge. Wet the shells and bake for 30 minutes at 180°C, adding cheese after the first 15 minutes.

ingredients.name: Saved cooked filling
ingredients.note: The half saved from the 1 kg mince batch; already cooked and refrigerated. This serves two.

ingredients.name: Water for dipping the shells
ingredients.note: Briefly wet the shells or tortillas before filling them.

afterSteps.title: Use the saved filling
afterSteps.description: Use the cooked half saved in the fridge for tonight’s two portions. Preheat the oven to 180°C. Keep the filling chilled until we’re ready to assemble.

afterSteps.title: Wet the shells and add the cold filling
afterSteps.description: Briefly wet the soft taco shells in water, line them in the baking dish and divide the cold filling between them. Keep the cheese aside for now.

afterSteps.title: Bake for the first 15 minutes
afterSteps.description: Bake at 180°C for 15 minutes without the cheese. This is the first half of the 30-minute bake.

afterSteps.title: Now add the cheese
afterSteps.description: Carefully take the dish out and sprinkle generously with the favourite cheese blend.

afterSteps.title: Bake for another 15 minutes
afterSteps.description: Return the dish to the oven at 180°C for another 15 minutes, making 30 minutes in total. Check the filling in the centre is steaming hot throughout before serving. If it needs longer, keep heating until it is hot right through.
afterSteps.doneness: The filling is steaming hot right through the centre. Serve with the sides we fancy.
